caption_draft:
Your app is live. Now see what it is doing, with these 6 free tools.

UptimeRobot — https://uptimerobot.com/ — 50 monitors for free
Sentry — https://sentry.io/pricing/ — 5k errors on the free plan
PostHog — https://posthog.com/product-analytics/pricing — 1M events free every month
Better Stack — https://betterstack.com/pricing — Free: 10 monitors, 1 status page
Grafana Cloud — https://grafana.com/products/cloud/free-tier/ — Free forever, 14-day retention
Firebase Crashlytics — https://firebase.google.com/products/crashlytics — Free crash reports for mobile apps

Save this for the day your first app goes live. Send it to the friend whose app went down and nobody noticed.

#webdev #monitoring #buildinpublic #firstyear #students #coding #devtools #notyourcollege
